rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality early/degenerative blastocyst with absent/ill-defined ICM and sparse TE, consistent with 0DD; minor uncertainty/fabrication around collapse and granular debris prevents a perfect score.

Integrates age, ovarian response, endometrial thickness, BMI, male factor, prior IVF failures, and miscarriage history well, though some links to embryo quality versus uterine factors could be more tightly prioritized.

Overall logic is consistent: poor morphology plus repeated failures leads to low prognosis, and the implantation estimate follows reasonably; minor hedging and some diffuse discussion of fresh/freeze strategy reduce clarity.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice (SET, luteal support, no bed rest, consider cavity workup/PGT-A selectively); a few speculative suggestions and broad testing recommendations are less guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support, uterine reassessment, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and protocol review; useful but not highly specific to exact prior lab details.
